day_of_month.description: With every_months: the day of the month of each occurrence; the 29th to the 31st are the last day of a shorter month.

ends_on.description: No occurrence after this date; leave it out for no end.

every_months.description: Every 1, 3, 6 or 12 months: monthly, quarterly, half-yearly or yearly, with day_of_month; leave every_weeks out.

every_weeks.description: Every week or every two weeks, on the start's weekday; leave every_months and day_of_month out.

starts_on.description: The first occurrence is the first on or after this date; one in the past is made by the next run.
